notes.title: Important informations about Shop Tycoon
notes.content:
Hi! You haven't heard anything about Shop Tycoon for a long time. To answer the questions: no, Shop Tycoon is not dead, it is constantly being developed with the intention of bringing it to the first version of Early Access.

Some time ago we set ourselves the goal of having a playable prototype for the game by June 2021 and it actually happened!

In Shop Tycoon you can build a store, order goods, hire employees, employees put goods on the shelves, and customers come, take the goods from the shelves, go to the cash register and pay. The game is playable at this stage, but it is based on a lot of temporary assets and there is not as much fun in it as we would like to achieve, so you will have to wait a little longer before you can play - we predict that by the end of 2021, but this is not the last word.

We will try to inform you more regularly about the progress, and to those who would like to have the latest info, please visit the new Discord server - https://discord.gg/a8arm42qT6
We will also start working on a second devlog soon, and in the meantime you will get some screenshots and / or videos of the new content.

Thanks for the interest! :)

We are putting few links here for an easier access:
- Discord: https://discord.gg/a8arm42qT6
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/curiositstudio
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/curiositstudio
